notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
ODAT (Oracle Database Attacking Tool) runs all available modules sequentially against an Oracle TNS target: SID guessing, credential brute force, privilege checks, file upload/download, OS command execution capability tests.

=== DEFAULT CREDS ===
scott:tiger is a well-known Oracle default — always test first. DBSNMP:dbsnmp, SYS:change_on_install (Oracle 9), system:manager. Oracle 10+ no longer ships defaults but these persist in legacy installations.

=== SYSDBA ESCALATION ===
Even non-admin accounts may have SYSDBA privilege granted. Connect as sysdba → access SYS user → full DBA rights → sys.user$ table → all account password hashes.

=== FILE UPLOAD CHAIN ===
odat utlfile --putFile /var/www/html shell.php → curl GET confirms → web shell accessible → RCE on the OS level.
